name: Cymbal Aerospace Marketing
brief: Marketing and video generation studio powered by Gemini models like omni, nano banana etc. It brings creative briefing, storyboarding, image generation, motion video synthesis, voiceover/music scoring, and automated brand evaluation into a single studio interface.

iterations.title: Iteration #1: Initial Build
iterations.brief: Marketing and video generation studio powered by Gemini models like omni, nano banana etc. It brings creative briefing, storyboarding, image generation, motion video synthesis, voiceover/music scoring, and automated brand evaluation into a single studio interface.

items.label: Capture feature brief or stakeholder transcript (client-brief.md)
Scaffold workflow directories (issues/, issues/done/, ralph/)
Cache complex codebase/API exploration in research.md (optional)
Build disposable UI prototypes (prebuilt hand-drawn-ui / hifi-mockup-kit)

phases.title: The Grill Session (Native /grill-me)
phases.notes: Aligned on 6-stage Guided Studio Pipeline + Non-Linear Scene Canvas, Full-Stack TypeScript (@google/genai >=2.29.1 + Express/Fastify + SQLite/JSON + FFmpeg), Nano Banana 2.1 reference fusion + Omni 1.1 Flash keyframe-locked motion with stateful previous_interaction_id editing, Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS Voice Design + keyframe-conditioned Lyria 3.5 scoring with -12dB ducking, Multimodal Structured Brand Eval with 1-click auto-fix, and pre-seeded Cymbal Aerospace Brand Kit with non-destructive stale cascades.

items.label: Run native /grill-me interview against client-brief.md & codebase
Resolve decision tree dependencies one by one
Settle nasty edge cases (backfills, permissions, progression formulas)
Confirm shared design concept (Fred Brooks alignment)

phases.title: Destination Plan & Contracts (Native /plan + Prebuilt /sdd)
phases.notes: Generated issues/prd.md with 5 Deep Modules (CampaignVault, GeminiStudioGateway, StudioPipelineOrchestrator, MasterTimelineAssembler, StudioWorkspaceUI), behavioral testing boundaries, and negative Out of Scope constraints.

items.label: Review & approve proposed Deep Modules and interfaces (/plan)
Confirm behavioral testing decisions (test public interfaces, not internals)
Verify Out of Scope section records negative decisions from /grill-me
Generate issues/prd.md destination document (& optional specs/ contracts)

phases.title: Vertical Tracer Bullets (issues/NNN-*.md)
phases.notes: Sliced issues/prd.md into 7 end-to-end vertical tracer-bullet tickets (issues/001-*.md through issues/007-*.md) with explicit Blocked-by DAG dependencies and AFK/HITL classifications.

items.label: Draft vertical tracer-bullet slices from issues/prd.md
Ensure Slice #1 is an end-to-end Tracer Bullet (reject horizontal DB-only slices)
Classify each slice as AFK (autonomous) or HITL (human-in-the-loop)
Verify Blocked-by DAG relationships to unlock parallel branches
Write local markdown tickets (issues/NNN-*.md)

phases.title: Autonomous Execution (Native /goal, /compact & Prebuilt Swarm)
phases.notes: Completed all 7 vertical tracer-bullet slices (001 through 007) via Vertical TDD across 5 Deep Modules (CampaignVault, GeminiStudioGateway, StudioPipelineOrchestrator, MasterTimelineAssembler, StudioWorkspaceUI). All 7 Vitest test suites (9 behavioral tests), TypeScript typecheck, and Vite production build pass with 0 errors; tickets moved to issues/done/.

items.label: Rehearse single vertical slice iteration & observe agent
Verify strict vertical TDD (1 failing test RED -> minimal code GREEN -> repeat)
Verify automated feedback loops pass (tests + typecheck)
Verify structured commit & move completed ticket to issues/done/
Complete all unblocked AFK slices (via native /goal or prebuilt teamwork/swarm)

phases.title: Review & Live Browser QA (Native /browser + Prebuilt Critique)
phases.notes: Completed fresh-context automated code review and live 6-stage browser QA on http://127.0.0.1:4190. Resolved all findings via vertical ticket 008-phase6-review-and-qa-hardening.md and archived issues/prd.md to issues/done/prd.md.

items.label: Run fresh-context automated code review with pushed coding standards
Run live browser QA (Native /browser + prebuilt design-critique / chrome-devtools)
File any discovered QA bugs as new vertical tickets in issues/
Archive completed issues/prd.md into issues/done/ to prevent Doc Rot

phases.title: Deep Architecture & Memory (Native /learn)
phases.notes: Completed Ousterhout deep-module audit, adopted Design 3 (Caller-Optimized Stage Facade) for StudioPipelineOrchestrator in 009-refactor-deep-pipeline-orchestrator.md, and persisted architectural conventions in AGENTS.md.

items.label: Scan codebase for shallow modules & seam friction
Compare 3+ radical interface designs (Minimalist vs. Flexible vs. Caller-Optimized)
Persist architectural conventions via native /learn & file refactor tickets in issues/
